acceptance.scope: Quality label under author relative_v1 rules; no change to archived QC or automatic state adoption

annual.reference_load_definition: immutable baseline electricity demand before demand-flexibility redispatch; used for Base/V5 cost-intensity comparability

interpretation: Engineering dual comparison intervals, not statistical confidence intervals or market settlement
Each OPS year uses its own accepted Base-frozen source, not another OPS year as upstream
Start/stop variables are continuous GW capacities; equivalent full-capacity cycles are not discrete unit start counts
Service down/up calculated against each contracted service pool baseline; V2G discharge is separately reported and not added again to net-service down regulation
Province code 0 in six-scope dispatch means synchronous national sum

annual_rows.signs: Min LP, capacity rows L: raw pi normally <=0. Raw signed pi retained; capacity value = -sum(pi).
annual_rows.units_note: Task legacy rent_million_cny_per_year stores requested sum(pi), whose actual unit is million CNY/GW, NOT cash/year. Legacy rent_per_gw=sum(pi)/capacity has unit million CNY/GW^2. Use explicitly unit-named columns. capacity_rent=-sum(pi)*capacity is million CNY.
annual_rows.binding_note: hours_binding is abs(pi)>1e-6 as requested; dual-active proxy, not primal slack verification. AC uses shared bidirectional row; no identifiable separate direction counts. DC has no reverse row.
annual_rows.voltage_note: voltage_class absent in archived transmission_capacity.csv; left empty, not inferred.
annual_rows.annual_capacity_units: intra_load_center_annual_capacity constrains annual GWh flows by design_hours*capacity_GW; raw pi unit million CNY/GWh.
